reviewed.topic: Case link authority (ET-SEC-16) — one decision for single, bulk and case-workspace link/unlink
reviewed.note: All five link/unlink paths call authorizeCaseEvidenceLink (case access -> EVIDENCE_LINK matrix -> record access). ET-SEC-16 fix is present. Residual role-derivation defect in resolveCaseRecordAccess: UC-CASE-002.
resolveCaseRecordAccess requires evaluateMemberAccess (ACTIVE membership, expiry, org lifecycle) before case owner / CaseAccess narrowing; personal (teamId null) case is owner-only.

reviewed.topic: Case link: case belongs to workspace / cross-tenant refusal
reviewed.note: Strict evidence.teamId === case.teamId inside the one attach authority, plus same-owner rule for null-team pairs; route also emits CROSS_TEAM_ATTACH_BLOCKED. Cross-tenant caller gets 404 (concealed) from authorizeCaseEvidenceLink.
EVIDENCE_LINK allows OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER or assigned OWNER/INVESTIGATOR; VIEWER refused — except a VIEWER on a case access list is re-labelled MEMBER (UC-CASE-002).

Link row + tenant audit (cases.evidence_linked) commit in one transaction. The existence check runs before the transaction (race: UC-CASE-004). The route-level audit cases.add_evidence and analytics are written after, outside the transaction. There is NO capture-time link, so 'link in the same transaction as the evidence' does not arise: every link is a post-hoc second operation on an already-created record, and a failed link leaves the record intact and unlinked.

Sequential re-attach returns created:false (200). Re-detach is zero-mutation but POST/DELETE route answers 400 'Evidence is not in this case' (not an idempotent 2xx). Concurrent attach not idempotent (UC-CASE-004).
Lists via caseLinks (the one relationship table). Trashed records (deletedAt set) drop out of the simple case count/list.
Only the earliest linked case is projected (UC-CASE-005).

cases.evidence_linked / cases.evidence_unlinked tenant audit with actorUserId, caseId, evidenceId, ip, UA; plus route audit cases.add_evidence / cases.remove_evidence. No custody-chain event is written for case membership changes (custody log does not show case linkage).

findings.title: Evidence can be unlinked from a case under an active CASE legal hold, silently removing the hold's protection
findings.userImpact: Any case writer (MEMBER, assigned INVESTIGATOR) can remove a held record from the held case via Remove from case, bulk REMOVE_FROM_CASE or matter-workspace unlink; afterwards the record is no longer held and can be trashed, and later destroyed by retention.
findings.legalImpact: Defeats a preservation obligation: a case-scoped legal hold covers exactly the records currently linked, and linkage is mutable by non-admins with no hold check. Case deletion is refused under the same hold precisely because it detaches links, so the gap is inconsistent with the platform's own rule.
findings.securityImpact: Within-tenant integrity/preservation bypass; no cross-tenant access.
findings.reproduction: 1) Workspace case C with linked evidence E; place an ACTIVE hold scope=CASE caseId=C. 2) As a MEMBER: DELETE /v1/cases/C/evidence/E (or POST /v1/evidence/bulk {action:REMOVE_FROM_CASE}, or DELETE /v1/cases/C/evidence-links/:linkId). 3) Returns 200; case_evidence_links row deleted. 4) evaluateEffectiveLegalHold(E) now resolves no linked case -> not held; POST trash on E succeeds.
findings.observed: detachEvidenceFromCase deletes the link row with no hold evaluation; none of its three callers evaluates holds. evaluateCaseDeletionHold is used only for case DELETE.
findings.expected: Detaching evidence from a case that carries an ACTIVE CASE hold (or while the evidence is otherwise held via that case) is refused (403 LEGAL_HOLD_BLOCKED, fail-closed 503 when hold state unreadable), inside the one detach authority so no caller can skip it.
findings.rootCause: The case-hold scope is computed dynamically from mutable links (resolveLinkedCaseIds), but the one detach authority treats linkage as a pure relationship edit and has no preservation gate.
findings.remediation: In detachEvidenceFromCase (and detachAllEvidenceFromCase) evaluate ACTIVE holds with scope=CASE for caseId (and historical holds) inside the transaction, fail closed; map to 403 in cases.routes, case-workspace and bulk. Alternatively snapshot case-hold membership at hold placement.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: CASE hold active -> single, bulk and case-workspace unlink all refused with zero mutation; hold store unreadable -> 503 zero mutation; after hold release unlink succeeds; trash after refused unlink still blocked.
findings.runtimeProbe: Disposable PG: create team, case, evidence, link, evidenceLegalHold{scope:CASE,status:ACTIVE}; call DELETE /v1/cases/:id/evidence/:eid as MEMBER; assert 200 today (expected 403) and isEvidenceUnderAnyLegalHold(eid) flips true->false.

findings.title: A workspace VIEWER granted case access is treated as MEMBER by the case mutation matrix and can unlink evidence (and perform other case mutations)
findings.userImpact: Read-only members on a restricted case can remove evidence from it; their attempt to add evidence passes the case-link authority and then fails as an unmapped 500 inside attachEvidenceToCase.
findings.legalImpact: A read-only reviewer can alter a matter's evidence set (and, with UC-CASE-001, its hold coverage).
findings.securityImpact: Within-tenant privilege escalation VIEWER -> case writer.
findings.reproduction: 1) Team member V with role VIEWER. 2) Owner grants V CaseAccess on case C (POST /v1/cases/C/access; only isActiveWorkspaceMember is checked). 3) V: DELETE /v1/cases/C/evidence/E -> authorizeCaseEvidenceLink: resolveCaseRecordAccess returns role 'MEMBER' because c.access.length>0; EVIDENCE_LINK allows MEMBER; detach runs (no record-level write check) -> 200. 4) V: POST /v1/cases/C/evidence {evidenceId} -> authorization passes, attachEvidenceToCase requires evidence.update_metadata, throws CaseEvidenceAuthorityError outside any try -> central handler 500.
findings.observed: role: c.access.length > 0 ? "MEMBER" : (membership?.role ?? "MEMBER") — the access-list branch discards the member's real workspace role.
findings.expected: The access list narrows who may open the case; it never widens the member's role. accessRole must be the membership role (VIEWER stays VIEWER), so the VIEWER hard rule in evaluateCaseMutationPermission applies.
findings.rootCause: resolveCaseRecordAccess synthesizes MEMBER for any access-list grantee; the unlink path relies solely on that role (detach has no record-access check).
findings.remediation: Return membership.role for access-list grantees (default VIEWER when no row, never MEMBER); map CaseEvidenceAuthorityError to 404/403 in cases.routes POST.
findings.requiredTests: case-link-authority.integration: VIEWER in CaseAccess refused 403 on single/bulk/case-workspace link and unlink and on status change; MEMBER in CaseAccess still allowed.
findings.runtimeProbe: Seed VIEWER + CaseAccess row; call authorizeCaseEvidenceLink({userId:viewer, caseId}) -> expect allowed:false/403; today allowed:true accessRole MEMBER.

findings.title: Case-bound intake links and evidence requests never add the submitted evidence to the case; the case appears only as a label
findings.userImpact: An organization that issues an intake link or evidence request for a matter receives evidence that does not appear in the matter's evidence list, reports tab, hold scope or case export; the evidence detail source card says 'Case / matter <id>' and mobile offers 'Return to matter', implying membership.
findings.legalImpact: A CASE-scoped legal hold does not cover evidence collected for that case through its own intake link; case exports/SIU bundles omit it.
findings.reproduction: POST /v1/workflow/intake-links {teamId, caseId:C, ...} (or POST /v1/evidence-requests with caseId). Submit through /v1/external-intake/:token/sessions/:sid/submit. Query case_evidence_links for the new evidence: none. grep: no writer uses CaseEvidenceLinkSource INTAKE or WORKFLOW; attachEvidenceToCase callers are cases.routes, evidence bulk and case-lifecycle only.
findings.observed: caseId is validated (ET-SEC-33) and stored on the link/request, echoed in summaries and webhooks, but never turned into a CaseEvidenceLink.
findings.expected: When an intake submission finalizes for a link/request carrying caseId, attachEvidenceToCase is called (source INTAKE, actor = link creator or system) in the finalization path, idempotently; or the field is removed and not presented as case membership.
findings.rootCause: Intake/request caseId was designed as metadata; the case-evidence authority has an INTAKE source value with no writer.
findings.remediation: Attach at intake finalization through attachEvidenceToCase with source INTAKE (re-validating case.teamId === evidence.teamId and case not closed); audit and surface failures as a retryable intake incident. Web wizard and EvidenceRequestPanel do not send caseId today, so the path is reachable via API/integrations only.
findings.requiredTests: Integration: intake link with caseId -> submitted evidence listed in case, covered by CASE hold; link without caseId unchanged; case deleted before submit -> evidence created, link skipped with audit.
findings.runtimeProbe: Create link with caseId, run a full intake submit in a disposable stack, then SELECT count(*) FROM case_evidence_links WHERE evidence_id=<new>; expect 1, observe 0.

findings.title: Attach 'one active link per pair' is enforced by read-then-write; concurrent attaches can create duplicate links or a 500
findings.userImpact: Double-submit of Add evidence / Link evidence with different roles yields two link rows for the same pair; with the same role the loser gets an unmapped P2002 -> 500 DATABASE_ERROR.
findings.legalImpact: Minor: duplicate relationship rows in case exports/graph.
findings.reproduction: Fire POST /v1/cases/C/evidence (role PRIMARY) and POST /v1/cases/C/evidence-links {role:SUPPORTING} for the same evidence concurrently; both pass findFirst and both insert (unique is (caseId, evidenceId, role)).
findings.observed: findFirst outside the transaction; unique index includes role.
findings.expected: Unique (caseId, evidenceId) or an advisory lock/ON CONFLICT inside the transaction; P2002 mapped to the idempotent created:false answer.
findings.rootCause: Invariant documented in the service header is not backed by a constraint.
findings.remediation: Move the existence check into the transaction under pg_advisory_xact_lock(case,evidence) or add a partial unique index on (case_id, evidence_id) after de-duplicating; catch P2002 -> return existing link.
findings.requiredTests: Concurrency test: N parallel attaches with mixed roles -> exactly one row, all callers 200.
findings.migrationImpact: additive (unique index after dedupe) or none (lock)

findings.title: Evidence detail projects a single 'primary' case (earliest link) and reads its name without case-access narrowing
findings.userImpact: A record linked to several cases shows only the first; 'Remove from case' can only target that one; other memberships are invisible on the record. A member who cannot open a restricted case still sees its name on the record.
findings.legalImpact: Reviewer may not know a record is also part of another (possibly held) matter.
findings.securityImpact: Within-tenant disclosure of a restricted case's name.
findings.reproduction: Link E to cases A (first) and B; open /evidence/E: relationships.caseId = A only; removeCase issues DELETE /v1/cases/A/evidence/E.
findings.observed: primaryCaseIdOf takes caseLinks[0] (orderBy linkedAtUtc asc, take 1); prisma.case.findUnique without resolveCaseRecordAccess.
findings.expected: Project all linked cases the viewer may open (listCasesForEvidence filtered by resolveCaseRecordAccess) and offer per-case unlink.
findings.rootCause: Legacy single Evidence.caseId response shape preserved after the many-to-many link table became the authority.
findings.remediation: Add relationships.cases[] (access-filtered) and drive the UI from it; keep caseId as deprecated alias.
findings.requiredTests: Render + API test for a two-case record and for a restricted case the viewer cannot open.

findings.title: Every report issued since share tokens prints a 'Public Verification' QR/link that answers 'Evidence not found' by default, and package README seal step 2c depends on that page
findings.userImpact: Records finalize NOT_PUBLISHED. The worker mints a REPORT-purpose pvs_ token and prints it on the report cover as 'Public Verification — Scan QR code or open verification page'. Until the owner separately publishes the record, /public/verify/<token> returns 404 'Evidence not found' — byte-identical to a forged/unknown link. The owner's links panel says the record is private but lists the printed link with a green 'Active' badge; nothing tells the owner that reports they hand out have a dead link.
findings.legalImpact: A recipient (court, counterparty) following the report's own verification instruction is told the evidence does not exist. The package README's seal verification step 2c (compare seal key fingerprint with Public Verify) and step 6 (signing key published on Public Verify) cannot be completed for a private record, so the package's independent-verification claim is unavailable by default.
findings.reproduction: Finalize a record (publicVerifyState NOT_PUBLISHED at evidence-complete.service.ts:1258); let the worker issue report v1; scan the cover QR -> GET /public/verify/pvs_... -> resolveVerificationShareToken ACTIVE -> evidence.publicVerifyState !== 'PUBLISHED' -> 404 {message:'Evidence not found'} (evidence.routes.ts:12832).
findings.observed: Report text and README promise a live public verification path; the path is closed by default and the closure is indistinguishable from non-existence.
findings.expected: Either (a) the report/README state that the link works only once the owner enables public verification, and the owner is told at download that the printed link is inactive; or (b) the 404 for a real-but-unpublished token answers a distinct 'not currently published by its owner' state (410-style) that does not deny existence; and the links panel shows REPORT links as 'Inactive — record not published'.
findings.rootCause: ET-PKG-07 made records private by default and gave reports their own token, but the report template, README and owner UI were not updated for the unpublished state; the public route collapses unpublished into not-found.
findings.remediation: Add a report-cover caveat and README note conditioned on publication at issuance; add a download-time/owner-panel warning; consider a dedicated 'withheld by owner' response for valid tokens on unpublished records (no metadata).
findings.requiredTests: Worker render test asserting the cover caveat for NOT_PUBLISHED records; API test: valid REPORT token on unpublished record -> documented response; web render test for the REPORT link badge when private.
findings.runtimeProbe: Disposable stack: complete evidence, run report job, read the token from verification_share_tokens via the returned PDF text, GET /public/verify/<token> -> 404.

findings.title: Case quick actions 'Generate report' and 'Create verification package' only switch to a status tab
findings.userImpact: Clicking either button changes local tab state; nothing is generated and the destination tab offers no generation control (it says to open each evidence record).
findings.reproduction: Open a simple case with evidence; click 'Generate report' -> onGoToTab('reports'); no request is made.
findings.expected: Label as 'View reports & packages', or wire a real per-record/case-level action.
findings.rootCause: Placeholder quick actions never connected to the output authority.
findings.remediation: Rename to navigation copy (or remove); no case-level output exists.
findings.requiredTests: Render test asserting the label/behaviour pairing.

findings.title: Package recovery reads the stored report latest-at-key instead of the report row's pinned s3VersionId
findings.userImpact: If a second object version ever exists at reports/<id>/v<N>.pdf (e.g. an interrupted earlier attempt uploaded after the committed one), package recovery fails permanently with REPORT_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH and the record is routed to 'integrity review' although the committed report is intact.
findings.legalImpact: No false output (digest check prevents it); spurious terminal failure.
findings.reproduction: loadCommittedReportForPackage selects s3VersionId but readVerifiedStoredReport(report) calls headObject/getObjectStream without versionId.
findings.observed: Unpinned read; sibling of the ET-PKG-15 originals fix.
findings.remediation: Pass and use s3VersionId in readVerifiedStoredReport (and in the report/latest HEAD probe).
findings.requiredTests: Worker unit test with a storage double holding two versions at the key.

findings.title: Evidence detail report download collapses every refusal into 'Failed to download report' and reports expected refusals to Sentry
findings.userImpact: A legal-hold/export-policy block (403/409), a missing stored PDF (410) or a not-found reads as a generic failure; the package download and the Reports page map the same codes to reasons.
findings.reproduction: Place a hold that blocks export; click Download report on the record -> toast 'Failed to download report' and a Sentry event.
findings.observed: Hard-coded string instead of toSafeUserError/notifyApiError (the sanctioned error display).
findings.expected: Same mapping as downloadVerificationPackage / ReportsIndex triggerReport.
findings.rootCause: Handler never migrated to the safe-feedback path.
findings.remediation: Use notifyApiError with report-specific codes; suppress Sentry for bounded 4xx.

findings.title: Unpublished legacy records with team_id NULL can never be given a public verification link and are absent from the legacy-link inventory
findings.userImpact: Owner of a legacy Personal record gets 409 PUBLICATION_NOT_AVAILABLE record_has_no_workspace on 'Publish and create link'; the publication panel cannot address it either. The report/package pipeline was taught resolveEvidenceWorkspaceId for these rows, the share path was not.
findings.legalImpact: Such a record's printed report link can never become live.
findings.reproduction: Evidence with team_id NULL, publicVerifyState NOT_PUBLISHED: POST /v1/evidence/:id/verify-links -> 409.
findings.observed: if (!record.teamId) refuse; inventory where teamId = workspace.
findings.expected: Resolve the personal workspace (resolveEvidenceWorkspaceId) as the report writer does, or state the limitation in the panel.
findings.rootCause: Share/publication authority keyed on the raw teamId column.
findings.remediation: Use resolveEvidenceWorkspaceId for publication and inventory.
findings.requiredTests: Integration test for a NULL-team record: create link publishes and resolves.

recovery.qualifies: Finalized record (SIGNED/REPORTED), not TRASHED/DESTROYED/PENDING_DESTRUCTION/ARCHIVED, workspace resolved/active/not closed, caller has evidence.generate_report, entitlement ELIGIBLE, not in flight. Report: GENERATE when no report and no FAILED terminal; RETRY only for FAILED_RETRYABLE. Package: RECOVER when a report exists without its paired package and package is entitled and not governance-blocked (packages/shared/src/evidence-output-lifecycle.ts:1146). Legal hold does not block recovery of a missing output (it blocks NEW_VERSION and all downloads).
recovery.repairs: Missing package for the latest (or operator-named) report version, built from the stored, digest-verified report bytes (processor.ts:3564, 3230); failed retryable request re-enqueued as itself; first report+package pair; commercially/blocked terminal superseded by ordinal when the blocker has ended.
recovery.cannotRepair: Report integrity problems (REPORT_OBJECT_MISSING / INTEGRITY_MISMATCH / UNVERIFIABLE / MISSING_FOR_REPORTED) -> REPORT_INTEGRITY_REVIEW; technical terminal -> ESCALATED_TO_OPERATOR (operator supersede only); FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH record; legacy package without report (CONSISTENCY_REVIEW_REQUIRED); never mints a replacement report for an existing version.
recovery.duplicateOutputRisk: Low: ReportGenerationRequest.idempotencyKey @unique per (artifact, evidence, baseline version, force) + supersession head; clientRequestKey unique per evidence for NEW_VERSION; Report and VerificationPackage @@unique(evidenceId, version); worker pair_complete short-circuit.
recovery.historyPreservation: Versions are append-only (reports/<id>/v<N>.pdf, verification/<id>/v<N>.zip); request rows never rewritten/deleted (supersession adds :sN rows); NEW_VERSION never replaces earlier report; REPORT share token per version.
recovery.exactSourceVersionReuse: Package recovery embeds the stored report after size+pdfSha256 check, but reads latest-at-key, not Report.s3VersionId (UC-OUT-003). Originals are read at the pinned storageVersionId (ET-PKG-15).
recovery.overwriteRisk: Storage key is version-numbered and the committed row pins s3VersionId; a retried run can upload a second object at the same key before commit (bucket versioning retains both). No DB overwrite path: commit uses conditional updateMany + unique version.
recovery.idempotency: Recovery POST needs no client key (server key dedupes, collapses onto live job -> ALREADY_ACTIVE / SUPERSEDED / TERMINAL answers); NEW_VERSION requires Idempotency-Key and replays the prior request.
recovery.operatorViewAfter: Customer surfaces re-read outputs (state + generation outcome tone, withheld reason chip with tooltip: escalated, integrity review, legal hold). Operator path returns QUEUED / ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS / ALREADY_SATISFIED / NOT_ELIGIBLE with explicit message for 'requires explicit new version' and 'use Retry after exhausted failure' (remediation-executor.ts:307-323).

publicVerify.token: pvs_ + 32 random bytes base64url; SHA-256 hex at rest (packages/shared-runtime/src/verification-share/authority.ts)
publicVerify.states: unknown/malformed -> 404; revoked/expired/exhausted -> 410; record not PUBLISHED / trashed / destroyed / hash-mismatch -> 404
publicVerify.legacyGrace: 180 days from migration for records PUBLISHED at migration (legacyVerifyUuidUntilUtc); owner can end early
publicVerify.defaultPublication: NOT_PUBLISHED at completion (evidence-complete.service.ts:1258) — interacts with report-printed tokens (UC-OUT-001)
